purpose: Independent synchronized invasive-BP external stress test of the fixed MIMIC-BP PPG estimator

selection.eligible_definition: case contains all three required synchronized tracks

windowing.selection_within_case: evenly spaced over all QC-passing windows

comparators: destination-fold mean, reported only as supervised cross-fitted context
success_gate: at least 80 patients and 800 synchronized QC-passing windows; this is a stress test and has no accuracy-promotion threshold
claim_limits: No VitalDB result may be called prospective clinical validation
PaPaGei pretraining provenance must be considered before calling its representation strictly unseen
Cross-fitted destination calibration is supervised and must remain separate from zero-shot performance
